questions.questionText: How do single-celled organisms survive without a specialised transport system?

options.A: Their cell surface membranes are totally permeable.
options.B: They do not move very often.
options.C: They do not need to absorb oxygen.
options.D: They have a large surface area to volume ratio.

questions.questionText: An oxygen molecule diffuses directly from the air in an alveolus to haemoglobin in a red blood cell. What is the minimum number of cell surface membranes through which this molecule must pass?

For some diseases, one of the most effective measures for prevention and control is tracing people who have been in contact with infected people. For which disease would tracing the contacts of infected people help in its prevention and control?

options.A: Cholera, as it can be treated successfully with carefully selected antibiotics.
options.B: Malaria, as it is transmitted by animals, so the transmission cycle of the pathogen can be broken.
options.C: Measles, as it can cause an epidemic and can be controlled by other methods.
options.D: Sickle cell anaemia, as it is genetically inherited, so there is time to act before more individuals are affected.

questions.questionText: A child is vaccinated against a viral disease. A few weeks later she is exposed to the same virus. What is the expected response to this exposure?

options.C: large numbers of antibodies are released
options.D: large numbers of antigens are released

questions.questionText: Why has it proved difficult to develop an effective vaccine against malaria?

options.A: Mosquitoes have many stages in their life cycles.
options.B: The human immune system does not recognise the antigens of the parasite.
options.C: The parasites can only be attacked when outside the liver cells and red blood cells.
options.D: Vaccines are rapidly broken down by proteases in the stomach.

questions.questionText: Which statement describes a role of lymphocytes in the immune response?

options.A: B-lymphocytes divide to produce killer lymphocytes.
options.C: T-lymphocytes are involved in the humoral response.
